decisions.reason: As a close-to-core printer in a growing market with no negative signal after its first year, it remains a low-cost option to keep while the firm continues to learn about customer uptake.
This industrial laser line is presented as a flagship and fits the firm's Industry 4.0 direction, so management would be very unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.

The compact laser cabin builds directly on established laser capabilities and is still too new for uncertainty to be resolved, so the option value of keeping it is higher than the cost of continuation.
Although more specialized and potentially narrower in demand, the award and strategic fit with industrial marking suggest enough upside to justify keeping this option open for another year.
